title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
There!
Clean as a whistle!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The rabbits seem happy about their cage being clean again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks for giving me all those tips for cleaning efficiently, Minori. That helped a lot.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, Shiho, you said you were still trying to get the hang of things, but you really knew what you were doing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: When I first cleaned the cage, I remember flipping over their bowls by accident and slipping on the water...which was pretty embarrassing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure that has anything to do with knowing how this process works.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, we should start heading back.
We have that committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, we have like no time! We gotta hurry!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh...? Wait, Minori!
The meeting's that way!
Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That concludes our activity reports.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Next, announcements for this month...
I have a special bit of news today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A special bit of news...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes.
Please take a look at the last bullet point on the printout I gave you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The last bullet point...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, it says, “Applications to shadow with the caretakers at Odaiba Animal Land”!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: “Providing an opportunity for students to dive into the world of animal welfare by helping to take care of various creatures.”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: With that goal in mind, it seems they're accepting applications from students attending any high school in the city.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds like fun!
Odaiba Animal Land's a fully indoor zoo, right?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year B
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're pretty rare.
I remember seeing on TV how everyone goes to see the armadillos!

rows.Speaker: First-Year
rows.Line:
Armadillos are so cute!
I've even heard that a lot of people are keeping them as pets now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That does sound like fun!
It's not every day that you get to work with real animals at a real zoo. I might actually apply...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, this could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Please let me know if you're interested.
They'll be accepting applications all through this week.

rows.Speaker: Third-Year A
rows.Line: Hmm... I really wanna go, but I have to take a test at my cram school that day...

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line:
My club's going to a tournament!
I so wish I could go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I might not be able to go either since our schedule's been so packed lately.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Lemme take another look. This sheet says we'd be going the Saturday after next.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Wait a second!
If I recall correctly, the job on that day got cancelled.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Where's my planner...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yeah, I'm free! That means...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho, are you free on that day?
If you are, we could go—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I was thinking about practicing alone that day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-B-B-B-But...!
You just said that it might be fun...
Would taking a little break be that bad?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I'm sure all the animals are gonna be super cute! Like, the armadillos and the...uh...armadillos!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are they your only example...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-More importantly... You just said that you're “thinking about” having practice that day. That means you're not fully decided yet, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's gonna be so much fun! I bet you'll even get to hold lots of little critters!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hold...little critters...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We have been practicing a ton lately, so a break might not be a bad idea...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay! Woohoo!
We get to take care of animals together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, excuse me!
We'd both like to take part in the shadowing opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line: No fair! I wanna go!

rows.Speaker: Third-Year B
rows.Line: If it weren't for that tournament...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent.
Then, Hanasato, Hinomori, I'll let them know that you'll be going.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I'll get back to you on where and when you need to go on the day once all the details have been hammered out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, swear to uphold the honor of Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy's animal caretaker committee by doing the best job I can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, and...
I'm sure Shiho here feels the same way!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Geez...
What am I getting myself into?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope you have a fruitful experience.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
With that out of the way, that concludes today's meeting.
Thank you all for your time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!
After school
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ...is what happened.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, Shiho and I are gonna be going to the zoo to shadow as zookeepers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you and Shii?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair!
Taking care of animals at the zoo sounds like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Have you already heard specifically what you'll be doing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're gonna give us all the details when we get there... But I do know that we'll at least be cleaning where the animals live and feeding them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful!
I'd love to try feeding some large animals.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Large animals...?
Working with giraffes and elephants could be very fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... It's an indoor zoo, so I'm not sure they have any animals that big...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I did see on TV the other day that they have tapirs and emus there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, that's pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You should make the most of this opportunity since you don't normally get many chances to directly interact with those kinds of animals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I will! I'm super excited because Samo and the rabbits at school are the only animals that I usually get to interact with♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You said you'll be going the Saturday after next?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
Everything we had planned for that day got cancelled, so I decided to jump at the opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay... I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to hearing how it went.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You won't just hear how it went. I'll even bring back souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll definitely be looking forward to those!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Have fun, Minori!
Shadowing day
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Okay, I believe everyone's here.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Thank you all again for coming to shadow with us today. I'll begin by explaining your schedule for today. I hope you're all ready to have a wonderful experience.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I-I-I-It's really happening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Calm down.
Also, I didn't realize so many students from other schools would be here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I bet this is really popular because you get to take care of real animals! I mean, how lucky are we?!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, we've already assigned each school to a specific area of the zoo. Please turn to page two of your shadowing manuals.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, the names of all the schools are listed here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
In alphabetical order!
Alright, Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy starts with an “M” so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Found it! We're in the “Grassland Area” with the shoebill and chipmunks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Chipmunks...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Today's program is split into two halves. For the first half, you'll be taking care of the animals in the areas you've been assigned to.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Then, you'll all take a break. After that, for the second half, we'll have you all come take a look at what happens behind the scenes. Depending on how things go, we may end a little early or a little late.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Cool...!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Now, you'll all be heading over to be with the animals soon, but let me explain a little more before you do.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Taking care of the animals will involve both feeding them and cleaning up after them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Feeding and cleaning...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Before you feed them, you'll be measuring out a precise amount based on their prescribed diets.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Depending on the animal, you may need to cut slices of meat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow, that's pretty hands-on.
We really get to be zookeepers in that sense.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm guessing the chipmunks get nuts and berries...but what about the shoebills?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
They're big birds, so fish?
Then again, I've seen ostriches eat all sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll find out soon.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Once you've prepared their food, you'll feed them yourselves and proceed to clean up their habitats. When you've finished, the first half of your day will end.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Food prep, feeding, cleaning...
They're having us do more than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, since just cleaning the rabbit cage always takes a pretty long time...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: That concludes this brief explanation of what you'll all be doing today.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: The caretakers at each of the areas will give you all further instructions. Please feel free to start making your way over now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, we finally get to take our first big step as animal caretakers...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hang on, chipmunks, shoebill! We'll be right over to give you all the love you need!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: W-Wait, if you shout like that...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Hehe. That girl sure sounds excited.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Wait a minute. She looks really familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See? It might be a good idea to keep your voice down. What if people start figuring out who you are...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, good call...
Thanks for the heads up, Shiho!
A few minutes later
Grassland Area - Back Office

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My name is Minori Hanasato and I attend Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy! It's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm Shiho Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much for giving us this opportunity to help take care of the animals today!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Thank you both as well.
Welcome to the Grassland Area. My name is Nakazawa. I look after the animals here.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'll be working with the two of you all day, so please don't be afraid to ask me any questions that you have.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'm sure you two have already heard, but you'll be looking after the shoebill and chipmunks today.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
We'll begin by measuring out their food.
Why don't we start with the shoebill?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, the shoebill?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it eats fish?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Yes, we feed our shoebill rainbow trout and carp, but the ones in the wild survive on a staple of catfish and lungfish.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, catfish? But those are so big...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's amazing! They can really gobble them up whole...?! It'd take me at least three bites!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure that's something to brag about.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Hehe. That's not the only surprising fact about them. Shoebills are also known to eat snakes, frogs...and even baby crocodiles.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Baby crocodiles?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Yes, and because they don't have any teeth, they swallow them whole as you said. In that sense, they're very remarkable creatures.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, my assumptions about them are starting to change.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Are we gonna be okay...?!
What if it tries to eat me...?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: You should be fine since there have never been any reported cases of shoebills eating people. Also, they're very docile animals.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Yes!
I'm sure you'll understand when we go to feed our shoebill, Schubert.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Now, let's get his trout ready.
Shoebills don't actually have that big of an appetite compared to some other animals, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Throw the last one into the bucket, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, that should be it!
We're all set to feed Schubert!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All we did was move the fish into these buckets. I'm not sure that's anything to be proud about...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: The chipmunks' feed is also relatively simple to prepare, so this area isn't too bad in that department by comparison.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: We have a pygmy hippo just over there in a different area, which is apparently quite a handful.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'm told it needs to be given two to three fifteen-kilogram meals per day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It eats that much?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: And that's supposed to be on the low side. Elephants apparently eat five times that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep...!
I guess big bodies mean big appetites!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm kinda glad we were assigned to this area.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Oh, although some animals are easier to feed than others, they're all hard work to clean up after, so be prepared.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right!
We've done a lot of that for our school's animal caretaker committee, so we should be able to handle that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we're not talking about a rabbit cage here.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's wonderful to hear!
Actually, about how we'll be cleaning...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'd like for one of you to clean Schubert's habitat and the other to clean the chipmunks'.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Please talk it over and decide which you'll be cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Which do you wanna do, Shiho?!
I'm okay with either—

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The chipmunks.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll take the chipmunks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay!
You take the chipmunks! I'll take Schubert!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Oh, that was quick...
I thought you were going to decide after having a chance to feed the animals.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Anyway, we're all set to go, so let's head over to where Schubert is!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow... We finally get to meet Schubert!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Nod*
Shoebill Habitat

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This is Schubert...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I knew shoebills were big...
But he's really, really big up close!
He's about up to my shoulder!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Also...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
He's so calm and collected.
It's like he isn't bothered at all by our presence.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, meanwhile I jump whenever someone I've never met walks into the green room!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, not something to brag about...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Okay, now that you've met Schubert...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Let's get straight to the fun part of today's program. Feeding the animals!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-We finally get to feed Schubert...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How do we actually do that?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
You'll be feeding him by hand!
Put one of the trout in the palm of your hand and offer it to him like a present.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By hand...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I-I-I-Is that really okay?!
You just said shoebills eat baby crocodiles! What if he tries to chomp off our fingers...?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Remember, he wouldn't be able to since shoebills don't have any teeth. You'll be fine as long as he doesn't chomp down really hard.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: You'll need to go one at a time. Which of you would like to go first...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Uhh, I... I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll go first.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sh-Shiho?!
Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, since he seems pretty docile...
Also, chances like this don't come around often.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's the spirit!
Then, for our brave Ms. Hinomori, here's a trout!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here, Schubert.
It's time to eat.
se_event_keeper_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!
Odaiba Animal Land
Shoebill Habitat

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
He's eating it!
He's really eating the fish you gave him!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... He is...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Excellent job!
Schubert seems to be really enjoying it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I couldn't really tell since his expression hasn't changed much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, this is...kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna feed him now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was already your turn next anyway, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Then, Ms. Hanasato, please bring him this nice trout.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you!
Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, Schubert!
I hope you're ready for seconds!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Did he not notice my fish?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Here!!
I have another fish for you! Bon appetit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huuuh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: He may be full after that fish you gave him, Ms. Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I could try giving him another one.
If he is full, he shouldn't react—

rows.Speaker: Schubert
rows.Line: *Nom*
se_event_keeper_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, he ate it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whyyyyy?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But I have a yummy fish for you right here! Why don't you want it?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He's completely ignoring you.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
That's strange...
He usually has a fairly big appetite...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whyyy?!
A few minutes later
Chipmunk Habitat

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Alright, we're all done feeding the animals in the Grassland Area! Thank you for your hard work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew. I'm so glad the chipmunks ate all the nuts and berries I gave them after Schubert gave me the cold shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wasn't it so cute how they nibbled away at them, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho?
Shiho, you there...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I didn't mean to space out...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I couldn't help but wonder a few things when that chipmunk hopped onto my hands to eat those nuts and berries...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For example, do they know that they're a human's hands instead of a branch or something...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And, I kept wondering how such tiny and adorable creatures are able to survive out in the wild...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-In any case, Shiho, I'm glad to hear that you've been enjoying everything!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, uhh...
We have to start cleaning next, right?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: That's right. This is where a zookeeper's stamina and mettle are really put to the test!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll each be cleaning the habitats for the chipmunks and Schubert, yes? Would you mind telling us more about what that actually involves...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
It's mostly fairly simple.
You'll just need to go in with floor brushes and scrub down everything from top to bottom.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's basically what we do for the rabbit cage!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then, let's go!
Shiho, you said you'll take the chipmunks and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to go back to where Schubert is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't sound very happy about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because Schubert doesn't seem to like me at all!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He ate the fish you gave him, but he didn't eat any of the ones I offered him...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. He just happened to not be hungry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You really think so?!
But! But...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, even if he doesn't like you now, I'm sure you'll figure something out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After all, you're really good at making new friends.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I am...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, you usually just keep trying and trying, no matter how cold-shouldered you get.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're here together now because of that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, um... Why don't you see how things go when you're cleaning and try to get close to him?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I have to keep believing that we can be friends, or else he'll just keep ignoring me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I may be a member of the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy animal caretaker committee right now, but my true identity is Minori Hanasato of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm an idol!
My job is to connect with others and spread hope to them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I'm gonna try my best!
I'm gonna inspire Schubert to believe in me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your reasoning's kinda weird, but I think you've got the right idea.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Hehe. You both sound ready now, so let's start cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: After I give you two a brief rundown of what to do, I'll be working in a different section nearby. Please come get me if you need any help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's start.
A few minutes later
Shoebill Habitat

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Pardon me!
I'm here to clean your habitat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Wince*
(His gaze feels so cold... But I can't give up!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm used to cleaning on the animal caretaking committee. I'm gonna surprise Schubert by making this place spotless!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Starting with his pool.
He drinks from it, so I need to make it really clean!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... I have to drain it first, by pulling this plug...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, and I can use this water to make everything nice and clean! Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Or two Schuberts with one stone!
Just kidding!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, he's still staring at me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, I think he's been slowly walking towards me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm sure I'm just imagining things!
Anyway, I need to work on making this place spotless.
se_event_keeper_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?!?!
He's so close! Does this mean we're friends now?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Y-Y-Yes, how can I help you?!
Why are you poking me with your beak?!?!
<Oh, this bird's so big.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<And it has a lovely beak.
It's so cute how it's poking you, Minori. I'm really jealous♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Luka?!
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <After you told us you'd be going to a zoo today, I was curious what animals they have.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<So...
I decided to drop in♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Still, you really startled me!
Thank goodness Shiho and Mr. Nakazawa aren't here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I made sure to wait until they were both gone, so don't worry♪ I'll hide when they return.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Also...
This shoebill's name is Schubert, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <He looks so big and powerful. I feel like he could gobble me up whole.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He probably does look really big right now because of how little you are on my phone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure you heard earlier, but he's really docile! He did start poking me with his beak just now for some reason... But he was as still as a statue when I was feeding him!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, you're right.
Even when I popped out, he didn't seem bothered at all.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <He may have what it takes to become an idol.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Even the most experienced idols feel a little nervous when they take the stage, no?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But nothing seems to faze Schubert. His poise is really remarkable.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
I could learn a lot from him...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. At the same time, he'll need to learn how to smile a little more before he can become one.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is it just me or does it seem like he wants to say something to us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, where are my manners?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <How inconsiderate of me. I completely forgot to introduce myself before evaluating you like that.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <My name is Megurine Luka. Pleased to meet you, Schubert.>
se_event_keeper_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
D-Did you see that...?
I think Schubert just bowed to you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes...
It certainly looked like a bow.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It just looked like one...right?
Although, he—
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Ah, Ms. Hanasato, it seems that you and Schubert have worked things out!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Huh...? We have...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Shoebills bow as a display of affection! So if someone he considers a friend bows, he'll return the gesture.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
I didn't know shoebills did that...!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Hehe. Fascinating, aren't they?
There are actually some other things they do to show their affection.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'll bet he was trying to thank you for cleaning his habitat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Hehe...
But I'm not sure that bow was meant for me...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: No?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uhh... I think it just happened to look like a bow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, he didn't eat any of the fish I offered him!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Yes, I gave that some thought...
Shoebills are very careful and deliberate by nature.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Which makes me believe that he was mulling over whether or not he could or would eat your fish, whether he was allowed to eat it yet and so on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Yes. When you waved that fish in front of him, I'm guessing he was thinking about how he was actually going to eat it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yeah... Come to think of it, I think Shiho kept her hand completely still when she offered him that fish.)

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: In any case, he probably feels grateful that you cleaned his habitat for him.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Try bowing to him now. I'm sure he'll bow back when you do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He'll bow back...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I sure hope so...
But I still think that other bow was meant for Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Still!
If there's a chance, even a tiny one, I should give it a try!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Would you like for us to be friends?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Hehe. That wasn't quite a bow, but I'm sure he understands.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh... I guess I can't inspire Schubert...)
se_event_keeper_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*
Grassland Area

rows.Line: Minori's taking pretty long...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(To be fair, Schubert's habitat is a lot bigger...

rows.Line:

se_run_women_002_1

rows.Line: Shiiihooo!!!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Hehehe. Schubert and I are super duper good friends now!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: A crew...? Not a word you hear much lately...

rows.Line: But hey, I'm happy you're both friends now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: And...they were really cute.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great to hear!
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Line: Thank you two very much for all your hard work! Both habitats look completely spotless now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Mr. Nakazawa!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you for teaching us everything.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Actually, I was very impressed by how the animals took to you two so quickly. I think you both have what it takes to become zookeepers.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Anyway, this concludes the part where you work with the animals. Please come again to help if you ever get the chance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's take our break here.
After that, you'll need to head over to the room where you were given the rundown of today's program.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Oh, the second half mostly involves seeing what goes on behind the scenes in the back offices, so you can change back into your normal clothes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mr. Nakazawa, thank you again!
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Working with the animals was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm also looking forward to seeing what goes on behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
And how great is it that we get to go around the zoo during our break?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Where should we go?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it could be fun to see what animals they have there. Why don't we head over and—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, wait!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa, what's the big fuss?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That girl over there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That slim frame and beautiful posture...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The outfit she's wearing looks so simple, but she gives off this aura of being extraordinary...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It must be her!
The idol who's loved by everyone and continues to evolve every day! Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, there's no way.
Yeah, she looks pretty similar, but what are the odds of—
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika?!

rows.Line: Oh, Ichika's here too!
se_run_women_002_2
se_run_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, you two!
What brings you both here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori...!
Oh, and you're with Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well...
Since the cat's out of the bag.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After we heard that you'd both be shadowing here today, we planned to try to surprise you once you were all done.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We invited Saki, but she had a conflict.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh, okay...
I had no idea that you guys were planning anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But our cover's blown.
We didn't realize that it'd be over this soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Actually, we're not done yet.
We're on break, and they said it was okay to check out the rest of the zoo.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
So we have to head back when our break's over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But we still have time to hang out.
Let's go around the zoo together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
If you two still have time, then let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The two of us were planning on going around the zoo anyway while we waited for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The Savannah Area was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, the servals and caracals were really cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I didn't know that they were carnivores.
It was surprising to hear that they eat moles.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, where should we go next?!
Based on this pamphlet, the Wetland Area's right near here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
They have all sorts of fish, frogs and birds!
And lots and lots of different plants, and—

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Whoa, there he is!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Oh wow!
Look at him go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?
Everyone seems excited suddenly—
se_event_keeper_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? What's wrong...?
Why do you all look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, look at your feet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My feet...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eeeeppp!
Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-Who are you?!

rows.Speaker: Female Regular
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that...
Dylan's escaped again.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: E-Escaped...?!

rows.Speaker: Female Regular
rows.Line: Yes, Dylan the armadillo's become quite the escape artist because he likes going for strolls around the zoo so much.

rows.Speaker: Female Regular
rows.Line: That said, the staff are quick to catch on, so it always ends with him getting chased around. His escape attempts have lately become one of this zoo's unofficial attractions...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Attraction... Armadillo...

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds like fun!
Odaiba Animal Land's a fully indoor zoo, right?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year B
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're pretty rare.
I remember seeing on TV how everyone goes to see the armadillos!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Now I see...
This is what everyone was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've never seen one before in real life...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, if the staff are always chasing him around, shouldn't we tell them that he's here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Good point!
Since I'm here as a zookeeper for a day, I can't let him out of my sight!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, Dylan, it's time to go home!
Lemme carry you over so that the staff can—
se_event_keeper_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Dylan's making a run for—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Waaahhh!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...!
Minori, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Did you see the way he ran?!
The way he scurried along on his little legs was too adorable!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure now's the right time to be gushing over him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
For now, Minori and I will try to catch him.
Sorry, Kiritani, but can you let the staff know for us?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, sure.
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Wait, what do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Private Ichika, you can catch him with us! It's time for us to commence Operation: Detain Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Detain Dylan...?
Also, Private Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?! W-Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
He's so much faster than I expected!
I haven't even been able to get close!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, we can't really keep him in our sights because of all these people...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we can see him just barely now, but we'll lose him the second he runs into— *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, he really disappeared!
Where'd he go?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-He was running in this direction, so he couldn't have gone very far...
<Down the right passageway!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? The right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
There he is!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's go after him.
se_run_women_002_2
se_run_women_002_3

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The others probably believe that was someone from the crowd just now. But I'm guessing it was really...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Aha! It was Luka!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We're bound to succeed if she can help us!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We've gotta catch Dylan no matter what...!)
Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: He went that way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get him!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Hey, that girl looks really familiar for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Yeah, isn't she an idol or something...?
Why's she chasing Dylan around?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh oh...
Minori, I think your cover's been blown.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's okay... Well, not really...
But I'm Minori Hanasato the zookeeper right now, so I need to focus on catching Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
It's a dead end!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here's our chance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
You're trapped like a rat now, my armadillo friend!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Huff*
We're not letting you get away.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry.
We won't hurt you, so just stay still for us and—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, he's making a run for it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ichika, twelve o'clock!
Block his path!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...!!
se_event_keeper_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooo! He got away!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Just barely... We almost had him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ichika...?
Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Dylan's skin...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was incredible... It had such a rough texture...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still not the right time to be gushing over him.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Line: We've been running around for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Dylan keeps getting away...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think we've gone around the entire zoo now. Look, we're back in the Grassland Area...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Schubert seems to be pointing his cold gaze towards us for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What if he's making fun of us for not catching Dylan sooner...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I thought you two were friends now.
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How are you all doing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were you able to call the staff over?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was.
They're bringing over nets and other gear, so they should be able to catch—

rows.Speaker: Zookeepers
rows.Line: Hold still for us, Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Zookeepers
rows.Line:
Take this part of the net!
No, not that part! This part...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe we should help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Zookeepers
rows.Line:
No, Dylan!
Don't go that way!
se_event_keeper_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
He's coming right towards me...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
He's going straight towards you, Minori...!
This might be your chance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You can do it!
You'll block his path if you time it right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: T-T-T-T-Time it right?! How...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Minori, I'll give you the signal.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Luka...!

rows.Line: (That's right. If I have Luka assisting me, then I might actually be able to...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Come here, Dylan...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<He's still too far.
Just a little bit closer and...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Now!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You're miiiiiine!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: He dodged her...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
He really is a slippery one...
We should probably get more staff to—
se_event_keeper_2023_005

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What was that?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-It sounded like gunfire...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The noise stopped Dylan in his tracks...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now's my chance!)
se_run_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Shiho?
se_event_keeper_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Line: Got him!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You...

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
That was incredible!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You saved the day, Hinomori.

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:

rows.Line:
*Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wow...

rows.Speaker: Minori

Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out, Minori.
There's a news article online about you and the others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “Minori Hanasato and Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP! teamed up to capture an escaped armadillo...”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
“...and all the guests applauded when they succeeded.”
That's pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To be fair, Shiho was the one who caught Dylan, not us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They embellished the story a little... But I guess they didn't write anything negative.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and I heard that your shadowing went very well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii had such a wonderful expression on her face while she told me about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad it was fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It really was! And after it ended, we even went around with Haruka and Ichika to all the places that we missed during our break!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Including the petting zoo...
Shiho looked so happy while playing with all the cute little animals.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She also looked really sad when it became time for us to leave.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She really fell in love with that baby lop-eared rabbit...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Shiho and Haruka couldn't stop talking about penguins after that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, she also really likes them.
We even made plans to go to the Penguin Cafe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It's great that you two got to chat over a shared interest.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You got to help take care of the animals and see the entire zoo... That certainly sounds like a full day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot!
Luka came to visit during all that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, she did?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. She told me where to go and stuff while we were trying to catch Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I couldn't...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<There wasn't much you could do.
I mean, I wasn't expecting him to jump like that.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No fair, Luka.
I wish I could've seen Dylan.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Me too!
You could've told us where you were going!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Luka...! Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hello, Minori.
I decided to drop by again♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I should've gone with you last time.
I probably would've gotten to see all those animals...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry, Rin.
I was worried that us all going together would cause Minori and the others too much trouble.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't all of us go together sometime?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <All of us?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I really want to go now after hearing about what happened.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Really?!
Let's go! Right this second!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Right now may be a bit difficult...
But I'd also like to go.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They have a wide variety of animals, large and small, yes? I'm interested in seeing the frogs since I heard that some are supposed to have pretty patterns!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Frogs...?
I think I'll pass...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you're all aching to go. In terms of when, how about—

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there's the bell.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait, we have that assembly today!
We gotta get over to the gym!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What?! You're going?!
But we still haven't decided when we're all going to the zoo!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Rin, you should ask so much of them.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The zoo's not going anywhere, so we can talk about it again later.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Then, we'll talk again in SEKAI.
For now, have a nice day!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, see you guys later!
Gym

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: ...and that's why I took this opportunity today to tell you about a writer who calls this school her alma mater. I hope you all get a chance to read her works.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Mhm...
The principal's stories always make me feel so sleepy for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know they're supposed to be educational, but I just can't process anything...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Next, we have commendations.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: This time is usually for clubs and committees that have made significant accomplishments.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: But today, the school has received a letter of appreciation, which I would like to read out.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Shiho Hinomori from Class 2-B.
Minori Hanasato from Class 2-D.
Please come up to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Class 2...Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-What?! Me?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Is this about the zoo?
For now...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess I should go up.)
se_walk_women_005_3
se_walk_women_005_2

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Ahem. We've received a formal letter of appreciation from Odaiba Animal Land where you both shadowed...

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: “When working with our caretakers, not only did your students perform their duties magnificently...”

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: “They also connected with the animals, showed a deep compassion for them and even kept our zoo safe.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We kept it safe...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm guessing they're referring to us catching Dylan.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line:
“On behalf of the zoo, I would like to take this opportunity to recognize your students' efforts and achievements. From the bottom of my heart, thank you.”
Your work has not gone unnoticed, it would seem.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting this to happen...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me neither... But I'm glad we were able to help. Plus, I got to become friends with Schubert.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you had a lot of fun while feeding the chipmunks, Shiho! The face you made was so cute! Let's keep doing our best as members of the animal caretaker committee!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Talk about a hot mic...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Did everyone just hear that...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You...

rows.Line: You didn't need to tell them about the chipmunks!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm really sorry, Shiho!
